objective: Reconstruct Document AI from a release and evidence contract through page parsing, document assembly, table structure and minimum OCR foundations.
source_boundaries: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 official docs for page-level text, formula, table and reading order claims, not whole-document hierarchy
MinerU-Popo for cross-page text and table truncation, title hierarchy, image-text association and overlap synchronization
DoclingDocument as a unified typed IR implementation example, not a mandatory standard
Ai2 olmOCR 2 and arXiv:2510.19817 for unit-test rewards and evaluation, not product-specific business rules
PubTabNet and TEDS for HTML table structure similarity, not semantic numeric correctness or provenance
PP-StructureV3 official docs for layout, table, formula, chart, reading order and Markdown modules, not document assembly

required_decisions: score relations from independent evidence channels
distinguish missing, slot collision and schema overflow
release only when all source, relation, table and citation gates pass

qa.build_tsc: blocked by pre-existing unrelated corpus errors

findings_applied: connect runtime viz from page packet through document tree, verified table, RAG node and release gate
add primary SourceNotes to runtime evaluation
distinguish actual slot collision from schema overflow

small_model_pipeline: freeze one relation or one document transition
declare one source claim and forbidden extrapolation
normalize typed input and expected output
derive accept, review or reject oracle
test formula, viewport, overflow, console and route contract
record stop rule and deployment evidence
